input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months' fees and limit HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term.
input.comment: [Playbook] We can live with the mutual ninety (90) days' notice, but not with an uncapped exit payment or an HDI walk-away mid-term: we cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees and require any HDI-specified Termination Date to fall at the end of the then-current term.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date"), provided that a Termination Date specified by HDI shall be the end of the then-current term.

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable by the Company to HDI hereunder for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
